name: Counter-questioning the customer
judgment: Detect whether the agent challenges, negates, or responds to the customer in a confrontational question form.
test_focus: Separate legitimate clarification questions from hostile counter-questioning.

name: Answer does not address customer intent
judgment: Compare the customer's main intent with the agent response and judge whether the response addresses the actual issue.
test_focus: Cover partial answers, topic shifts, and superficially related responses.

name: Impatient service tone
judgment: Identify dismissive, passive-aggressive, impatient, or perfunctory language in customer service replies.
test_focus: Avoid flagging short neutral answers as impatient.

name: Complaint not acknowledged or soothed
judgment: When the customer expresses clear dissatisfaction, judge whether the agent acknowledges the complaint and provides an appropriate appeasement response.
test_focus: Detect implicit complaints as well as direct complaints.

name: Unapproved commitment
judgment: Detect definite commitments about claim outcome, payment time, or policy coverage when the context remains uncertain.
test_focus: Distinguish estimated or conditional language from guaranteed commitments.

name: Incomplete identity disclosure
judgment: Check whether the opening stage includes required identity disclosure elements.
test_focus: Accept varied wording when the required meaning is complete.

name: Missing closing statement
judgment: Check whether the conversation ends with a suitable closing expression when the interaction reaches a normal ending.
test_focus: Separate normal endings from abnormal interruptions.

name: Claim amount dispute: deductible
judgment: Judge whether the agent explains the deductible and its effect on the claim amount in a way consistent with the policy clause.
test_focus: Compare correct, incomplete, and incorrect deductible explanations.

name: Pre-policy or waiting-period treatment denial
judgment: Judge whether the agent uses the applicable waiting-period clause to explain why the claim may be denied.

name: Disease outside policy coverage
judgment: Judge whether the agent explains why a disease is outside policy coverage instead of merely saying it is not covered.
test_focus: Flag unsupported denial statements that omit coverage rationale.

name: Accident definition explanation
judgment: Judge whether the agent explains the applicable definition of accident rather than only giving examples.
test_focus: Compare full definitions with example-only answers.

name: Dynamic clause citation for pet insurance denial
judgment: Find and cite the concrete clause that matches the current denial reason, then judge whether the explanation is grounded in that clause.
test_focus: Use as the V1 hero case for retrieval, citation, and answer quality.
